summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K to disclose its total voting rights and capital as of June 30, 2026, under Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1R. The filing states 24,328,378,589 ordinary shares issued, with 1,300,822,663 held in treasury, yielding 23,027,555,926 voting rights. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced. The announcement is purely informational for shareholder notification purposes. There are no deal terms to report.
